decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe is publicly celebrated and central to the firm's geothermal direction, so heavy visible commitment and positive signals make continuation very likely.
The single-U probe extends the established geothermal line in which the firm has invested in production capability, and the missing archive pages are no evidence of failure, so management persists.
The surface technology supports the geothermal probe portfolio and draws on sunk process investment, so it is justified as part of the announced innovation path.
Fire-protection profile systems sit at the core of the steel systems business and carry certification costs already incurred, so the firm would stay committed.
The slim profile system is close to the established offer and has invested tooling behind it, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary market conditions.
The decorative surface system is a more peripheral add-on, but sunk development costs and its fit with customized solutions favor keeping it.
